title: feat(runtime)!: refuse runtime package changes when replicas are declared on the Redis driver
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi968N7B64dDN7Noq8Fj3QSME)_

Fixes #31599

Maintainer ruling D1 on cloud#3814: 「多副本时拒绝」. Claim 6727421428 (`domain:server#4`, card-thread session_01ADHkmPnqZD15YnBkNbm1jJ), as amended by 6728532665; seat rulings A on the three open questions (one code, R6-style recipe wording, runtime's own ledger row).

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — narrowed: the seven runtime package doors (`POST /api/v1/packages`, `PATCH …/:id/enable`, `PATCH …/:id/disable`, `POST …/:id/duplicate`, `POST …/:id/ensure-customization`, `PATCH …/:id`, `DELETE …/:id`) answer `409 MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED` before anything is written when the deployment declares several replicas (`OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS` greater than 1, or `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE=true`) and the composed cluster service runs the `redis` driver; `POST /api/v1/automation/:name/clone` and `POST /api/v1/security/permission-sets/:name/clone` answer the same only when their default landing would create the source's paired customization package on this replica. Measured by the ablation that removes the condition (the base behaviour): every refused door answered `2xx` and ran its writer on base. Every other topology is unchanged. Widened: `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` (`@objectstack/spec`) registers the already-registered code under `@objectstack/runtime` too (one row per emitting package); nothing is removed or renamed. A registered ledger row is a published schema, so this PR takes a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：部署声明了多副本(`OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS` 大于 1 或 `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE=true`)且集群驱动是 Redis 时，运行时的 7 个包门(安装、启用、停用、复制、确保定制包、改清单、删除)直接返回 409 `MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED`,提示在维护窗口里单副本或用 CLI 操作、再重启所有副本；流程和权限集的"新建相似"只在需要新建配对定制包时才拒绝。
- 为什么改：包注册表只在启动时读，启用/停用状态按副本各自保存，所以运行时改包只改到处理请求的那一个副本，其他副本看不到，重启后还会各自不同。维护者 D1 裁决「多副本时拒绝」。
- 风险与回滚：只在"声明多副本 + Redis 驱动"时生效；单节点、内存驱动、没有集群服务时字节不变；发布/草稿/回滚等元数据写门写共享库，不拒绝。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/multi-replica-package-refusal.ts`(新文件，复用 #31602 落地的 `declaresMultiReplicaOnRedis`);`domains/packages.ts` 7 处调用点;`automation.ts` 与 `permission-set-clone.ts` 的两处克隆门；账本新增的一行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/packages-capability-gate.test.ts src/domains/automation-flow-clone-custom-package.test.ts src/domains/permission-set-clone.test.ts` —— 预期 209 passed,其中本卡新增 64 个。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地(账本新增一行走 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 复核)。

## What changes

Step 0, the doors that change the package registry or the per-replica package state, read on `cae8d8fe`:

| Door | Handler | What it writes today |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /packages` | `handlePackagesRequest` install branch | `protocol` install or `registry.installPackage`: a package in this replica's registry |
| `PATCH /:id/enable`, `/:id/disable` | same, enable/disable | `writePackageState`: the host store, or `OS_HOME/package-state/<env>.<project>.json` on this replica's volume; then the registry switch |
| `POST /:id/duplicate` | same | `protocol.duplicatePackage`: a new package |
| `POST /:id/ensure-customization` | same | `protocol.ensureCustomizationPackage`: the pair package |
| `PATCH /:id` | same, manifest edit | `protocol.updatePackage` (`sys_packages` + registry) or `registry.updatePackageManifest` |
| `DELETE /:id` | same | `registry.uninstallPackage` + `sys_metadata` removal |
| `POST /automation/:name/clone` | `resolveCloneTarget` → `land` | ensures `<base>.custom` when the default landing needs it |
| `POST /security/permission-sets/:name/clone` | `resolveDefaultCloneLanding` | same |

- **`packages/runtime/src/multi-replica-package-refusal.ts`** (new) — `packageChangeReachesOneReplica` reads the composed `cluster` service's driver per request and asks `declaresMultiReplicaOnRedis(process.env, driver)` from `@objectstack/service-cluster` (landed by #31602). `refuseMultiReplicaPackageChange` answers `409` with the code and the recipe ("make the change in a maintenance window: run it on a single replica or through the CLI, then restart every replica"). `multiReplicaPairCreationRefusal` refuses a clone only when this replica's registry does not hold the pair yet.
- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`** — the refusal at each of the seven doors right after `requireManageMetadata` and the walled-catalog refusal, before the body is judged or anything is read or written.
- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`**, **`permission-set-clone.ts`** — the pair-creation refusal right before the ensure. The flow door asks it inside `land`, after the engine has accepted the copy, so a refusal withdraws the registration as a refused landing already does; the permission-set door asks it through a `beforeEnsure` hook and throws a `409` the door's existing envelope renders.
- **`packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`** — `MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED` under `@objectstack/runtime` (seat ruling: one row per emitting package, no second waiver). The code was already in the union, so no reference doc changes (`check:docs` green).
- **Tests** — in the existing harnesses (shared-harness rule), each a new top-level `describe`: `packages-capability-gate.test.ts` (the `make()` fake kernel gains an optional `cluster` service), `automation-flow-clone-custom-package.test.ts` and `permission-set-clone.test.ts` (each `boot` gains `clusterDriver`). No existing case changed.
- **`.changeset/31599-runtime-package-doors-multi-replica-refusal.md`** — `patch` for `@objectstack/runtime` and `@objectstack/spec`; both declaration lines; `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`; Before / Now / Unchanged / Who sees it.

## Tests

- Package doors, for each declaration (`OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS=3`, `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE=true`) on `redis`, each of the seven doors: `409` with the code, the message names the maintenance window and "restart every replica", none of the registry or protocol writers ran, and `OS_HOME` stays empty (no package-state file). An `isSystem` caller is refused too; a caller without `manage_metadata` still gets the `403` first.
- CONTROLs, each of the seven doors runs its writer as before: a single node on `redis`, `OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS=1` on `redis`, declared replicas on the in-process driver (escape hatch), declared replicas with no cluster service. On a single node, disable writes `OS_HOME/package-state`, so the "nothing written" check would see a write.
- Unchanged: the five metadata write doors of the same table (publish-drafts, discard-drafts, commit revert, rollback, adopt-orphans) are not refused under declared replicas on `redis`.
- Flow clone (real `ObjectQL` + `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` rig): `409` when the pair is absent (no pair installed, nothing published, no row, the copy's registration withdrawn); `200` into an existing pair; `200` for an explicit writable target; CONTROLs on a single node and on the in-process driver.
- Permission-set clone: `409` when the pair is absent (no ensure, no save); `200` into an existing pair; environment-authored source and explicit target `200` with no ensure; CONTROLs on a single node, the in-process driver and no cluster service.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not refused, by design.** publish, publish-drafts, discard-drafts, revert, rollback, `commits/:commitId/revert` and adopt-orphans write the shared metadata store, which every replica reads (and the metadata cluster bridge fans out). The CLI's `os plugin disable` (`plugin-installation-store`) is the recipe's own path and is not an HTTP door.
- **The clone doors refuse narrowly.** Copying into a pair this replica already serves, or into an explicit writable target, creates no package, so it lands as before. A pair created on another replica only would still be "absent" here and refused, which is the safe answer.
- **Protocol-internal ensure callers** inside `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` are outside the claimed surface and are not touched.
- **The recipe's wording** follows R6 (#31602) and names the CLI and a single replica; it is one function, `multiReplicaPackageChangeMessage`.

## Verification

Head `5eb211c4` (fix `6a362f63`, tests and changeset `cecb6bff`, the collection-time import the test-source-alias gate asks for `5eb211c4`), cut on `origin/main` `cae8d8fe`; `main` has since moved 7 commits, none touching a file this PR changes.

<details><summary>Suites (os-verify-lock, every VERDICT command-exit 0)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: 563 files / 9117 passed, 19 skipped (`cecb6bff`); `typecheck` exit 0; the edited suite rerun on `5eb211c4`: 134 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-cluster test`: 10 files / 128 tests.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 823 files / 26079 passed, 1 skipped, 1 todo. `typecheck`: exit 0 with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`; at the script's default 4096 its `check:test-typecheck` leg ran out of heap in this container before reporting (no diagnostics; the diff to `spec` is one ledger string).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:docs`: exit 0, 246 generated files in sync.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` (full battery, narrowing arm): 440 passed, 3 skipped files / 3652 passed, 41 skipped tests (`5eb211c4`).
- Lint (`eslint --no-inline-config`) on `packages/runtime/src` and the ledger file: exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (negative pins)</summary>

`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `cecb6bff`; the tests import the runtime from `src`, so no rebuild leg.

- Marker `ABLATED_31599`: `packageChangeReachesOneReplica` always answers `false` (the base behaviour). **19 of 209 red**, exactly the refusal cases: 14 package-door cases (7 doors × 2 declarations), the `isSystem` case, and the two clone doors × 2 declarations. Every CONTROL and every unchanged case green. Restored: blob `aad86398` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Marker `ABLATED_31599_PAIR`: the existing-pair exemption removed. **2 of 75 red**, exactly the two "pair already served is reused" cases. Restored, blob == HEAD.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 93 families, each run with stdin closed and its exit recorded; `--ran` reconciliation: "93 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 93 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". All 93 exit 0, among them `check:error-code-provenance`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary`, `check:error-status-conformance`, `check:route-envelope` and `check:changeset-no-major`. The first pass on `cecb6bff` had five `spec` surface gates at exit 3 (no `spec` declarations built; green after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`) and `check:test-source-alias` red (the edited packages suite reaches `@objectstack/metadata` during collection; fixed in `5eb211c4` with the module-top import the gate prescribes, then green).

</details>
